function GameHelper:Init()
    local controller = Instance.new("Model")
    controller.Name = "GameController"
    controller.ModelStreamingMode = Enum.ModelStreamingMode.Persistent
    ValueHelper:InitByModel(controller,WeatherValue)
    ValueHelper:InitByModel(controller,TimeValue)
    controller.Parent = workspace
    return controller
end

function GameHelper:GetController()
    return workspace:WaitForChild("GameController")
end

    return workspace:WaitForChild("雪原"):WaitForChild("雪山控制器")
end

function GameHelper:Eat(player:Player,item:Model)
    if RunService:IsClient() then
        GameHelper.EatC2S:FireServer(item)
    else
        if not GameHelper:isAlive(player) then return end
        if not ResourcesItemHelper:IsCanEat(item) then return end

        local resLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(item)
        if player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.OnlyEatRawMeat) then
            -- 只能吃生肉
            if not item:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Meat)
            or item:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.CookedFood) then
                UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireClient(player,"You can only eat raw meat.")
                return
            end
        end

        if player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.OnlyEatMeat) then
            -- 只能吃肉
            if not item:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Meat) then
                UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireClient(player,"You can only eat meat.")
                return
            end
        end

        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid:Humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")

        local maxHunger = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(player,PlayerAttributeValue.maxHunger)
        local foodAddHunger = tonumber(resLo.param) or 1
        local HungerRecoveryBonus = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(player,PlayerAttributeValue.HungerRecoveryBonus)
        local addHunger = foodAddHunger + foodAddHunger * HungerRecoveryBonus

        local v_hunger:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(player,PlayerValue.hunger)
        if not item:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.CookedFood) then
            if item:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Meat) then
                -- 吃了生肉扣血
                if not player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.OnlyEatRawMeat) then
                    -- 扣除血量
                    humanoid.Health = math.clamp(humanoid.Health - 10,0,humanoid.MaxHealth)
                end
            elseif item:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.DetoxMushroom) then
                -- 吃了解毒蘑菇
                -- local v_poisonMeter:NumberValue = ValueHelper:WaitValue(character,CharacterValue.poisonMeter)
                -- v_poisonMeter.Value = math.clamp(v_poisonMeter.Value - 10,0,GameEnum.PosionMax)
                GameHelper:PlayerAddPoisionMeter(player,-10)
            elseif item:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.ToxicMushroom) then
                -- 吃了毒蘑菇
                -- local v_poisonMeter:NumberValue = ValueHelper:WaitValue(character,CharacterValue.poisonMeter)
                -- v_poisonMeter.Value = math.clamp(v_poisonMeter.Value + 10,0,GameEnum.PosionMax)
                GameHelper:PlayerAddPoisionMeter(player,10)
            end
        end

        if item:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Soup) then
            -- 喝汤次数
            GameHelper:MarkCharacterStats(player,GameEnum.CharacterStatsId.eatSoup)
        end

        if item:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Meat) then
            -- 吃肉次数
            GameHelper:MarkCharacterStats(player,GameEnum.CharacterStatsId.eatMeat)
            if not item:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.CookedFood) then
                -- 吃生肉次数
                GameHelper:MarkCharacterStats(player,GameEnum.CharacterStatsId.eatRawMeat)
            end
        end

        local v_warm:IntValue = item:FindFirstChild("降低寒冷值")
        if v_warm then
            GameHelper:PlayerAddFreezeMeter(player,v_warm.Value)
        end

        GameHelper:SetEatMark(player,resLo.id)

        v_hunger.Value = math.clamp(v_hunger.Value + addHunger,1,maxHunger)
        ResourcesItemHelper:DestroyItem(item)
        AudioHelper:PlayEffect("吃东西",player.Character.PrimaryPart)
    end
end

function GameHelper:TakeBullet(player:Player,item:Model)
    if not GameHelper:isAlive(player) then return end
    if not ResourcesItemHelper:IsBullet(item) then return end

    local resLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(item)
    local addCount = tonumber(resLo.param) or 1
    local v_bullet:IntValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(player,PlayerValue:FindFirstChild(resLo.ItemType))
    if not v_bullet then
        error("玩家身上无法访问未注册的子弹类型："..resLo.ItemType)
        return
    end

    AudioHelper:PlayEffect("储存/装备",player.Character.PrimaryPart)
    v_bullet.Value += addCount
    ResourcesItemHelper:DestroyItem(item)
end

function GameHelper:AddBullet(player:Player,bulletId:number,addCount:number)
    local resLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLo(bulletId)
    local v_bullet:IntValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(player,PlayerValue:FindFirstChild(resLo.ItemType))
    if not v_bullet then
        warn("玩家身上无法访问未注册的子弹类型："..resLo.ItemType)
        return
    end

    v_bullet.Value += addCount or 1
end

function GameHelper:GetCurBulletValue(player:Player,bulletTag:string)
    if not GameHelper:isAlive(player) then return end
    if not table.find(GameEnum.BulletTags,bulletTag) then return end

    local v_bullet:IntValue = ValueHelper:WaitValue(player,PlayerValue:FindFirstChild(bulletTag))
    return v_bullet
end

function GameHelper:PlayerDied(player:Player)
    InteractiveHelper:UndragItemServer(player)
    local character:Model = player.Character
    if not character then return end
    local humanoidRootPart:Part = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    ValueHelper:InitByModel(character,DragItemValue)
    character:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.PlayerRagdoll)
    character:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.DragItem)
    character:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.CanStore)
    character:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.PlayerDeath)
    GameHelper:GetPlayerGameData(player).alive = false

    ToolHelper:UnequipTools(player)

    local dropCFrame:CFrame = humanoidRootPart.CFrame + Vector3.yAxis * 3

    -- 书包里的东西掉落出来
    local bagParent = BagHelper:GetStoreParent(player)
    for i=1,#bagParent:GetChildren() do
        BagHelper:Unstore(player,dropCFrame)
    end

    -- backpack里东西都掉落出来
    local offsetY = 0
    local backpack = ToolHelper:GetBackpack(player)
    for _,tool:Tool in ipairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
        if not tool:IsA("Tool") then continue end
        if tool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Heal) or tool:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Bell) then -- 如果是医疗包/铃铛，掉落到地上
            tool.Parent = workspace
            -- tool:PivotTo(dropCFrame) -- 都放在一个位置会造成卡顿，估计是物理引擎计算排挤压力问题
            -- tool:PivotTo(dropCFrame + Vector3.new(math.random(-1,1),math.random(1,2),math.random(-1,1))) -- 方案1
            tool:PivotTo(dropCFrame + Vector3.new(0,offsetY,0)) -- 方案2
            offsetY += 1

            -- 加个高光
            local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
            highlight.Name = "死亡掉落高光"
            highlight.FillTransparency = 1
            highlight.Parent = tool
            tool.AncestryChanged:Once(function(child, parent)
                highlight:Destroy()
            end)
        end
    end
end

function GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(character:Model)
    if not character or not character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
        return false
    end

    local v_HP:NumberValue = character:FindFirstChild("HP")
    if v_HP then
        return v_HP.Value > 0
    end

    local humanoid:Humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then return false end

    return humanoid.Health > 0
end

function GameHelper:ValidateGroundSpawnRequest(player:Player, ground:Instance, maxDistance:number):Vector3?
    if typeof(player) ~= "Instance" or not player:IsA("Player") then return nil end
    if typeof(ground) ~= "Instance" or not ground:IsA("BasePart") then return nil end
    if not ground:IsDescendantOf(workspace) or not ground:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Ground) then return nil end
    if type(maxDistance) ~= "number" or maxDistance <= 0 then return nil end
    if not GameHelper:isAlive(player) then return nil end

    local humanoidRootPart = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not humanoidRootPart or not humanoidRootPart:IsA("BasePart") then return nil end

    local offset = humanoidRootPart.Position - ground.Position
    if offset:Dot(offset) > maxDistance * maxDistance then return nil end

    local gridPoint = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(ground,GroundValue.grid)
    if typeof(gridPoint) ~= "Vector3" then return nil end

    return gridPoint
end

-- 是否在营火内
function GameHelper:IsInCampfire(pos:Vector3,rangeOffset:number?)
    local campfire:Model = MapHelper:GetCampfire()
    local heat = GameHelper:GetCampfireHeat()
    local range = GameHelper:GetCampfireRange()
    local campfirePos = campfire:GetPivot().Position
    
    if heat > 0 then
        local offset = pos * CommonEnum.XZ - campfirePos * CommonEnum.XZ -- 水平距离
        local distance = offset.Magnitude
        return distance < range + (rangeOffset or 5)
    end
end

function GameHelper:GetCampfireDistance(pos:Vector3)
    local campfire:Model = MapHelper:GetCampfire()
    local campfirePos = campfire:GetPivot().Position
    local offset = pos * CommonEnum.XZ - campfirePos * CommonEnum.XZ -- 水平距离
    return offset.Magnitude
end

function GameHelper:IsInGemTower(pos:Vector3)
    if RunService:IsClient() then
        local gemTower = MapHelper:GetGemTowerModel()
        if gemTower then
            local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
            raycastParams:AddToFilter(gemTower)
            raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

            local hitResult:RaycastResult = workspace:Raycast(pos,Vector3.yAxis * -500,raycastParams)
            return hitResult ~= nil
        end
    else
        local grid1X,grid1Z = MapHelper:Pos2Grid1(pos)
        local gridType = MapHelper:GetMapGridType(grid1X,grid1Z)
        if gridType == MapHelper.GridType.GemTower then
            return true
        end
    end
end

function GameHelper:IsInDeerNoEntryZone(pos:Vector3)
    local op = OverlapParams.new()
    op:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.DeerNoEntryZone))
    op.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
    op.BruteForceAllSlow = true

    local hits = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(pos,1,op)
    return #hits > 0
end

-- 小鹿登场
function GameHelper:DeerTryAppear(state:number?)
    if not state then
        state = GameEnum.DeerState.Nromal
    end
    local deer = GameHelper:GetDeerController()
    if not deer then return end
    if deer:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Deer) then return end
    if deer:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.DeerLeave) then return end

    -- math.randomseed(tick())
    local spawnCFrame:CFrame
    if state ~= GameEnum.DeerState.Peep then
        local players = game.Players:GetPlayers()
        local count = #players
        for i=1,count do
            local player:Player = table.remove(players,math.random(1,#players))
            -- 角色死亡，不刷
            if not GameHelper:isAlive(player) then continue end
            local character = player.Character
            -- 在野猪战场，不刷
            if GameHelper:IsOnCave(player) then continue end

            local playerPos = character:GetPivot().Position
            -- 在营火附近，不刷
            if GameHelper:IsInCampfire(playerPos,50) then continue end
            -- 在钻石塔里，不刷
            if GameHelper:IsInGemTower(playerPos) then continue end
            -- 在小鹿禁入区，不刷
            if GameHelper:IsInDeerNoEntryZone(playerPos) then continue end

            -- local grid1X,grid1Z = MapHelper:Pos2Grid1(playerPos)
            -- local posX,posZ = MapHelper:GetGridPos(grid1X,grid1Z)
            for j=1,20 do
                -- 确保这个格子已经被初始化
                local dirX,dirZ = CommonFunc:GetDir2D(math.random(0,359))
                local spawnPosition = MapHelper:GetSafeLandingPoint(playerPos + Vector3.new(dirX,0,dirZ) * 30)
                if spawnPosition then
                    if GameHelper:IsInCampfire(spawnPosition) then continue end
                    if GameHelper:IsInGemTower(spawnPosition) then continue end
                    if GameHelper:IsInDeerNoEntryZone(spawnPosition) then continue end
                    spawnCFrame = CFrame.new(spawnPosition,playerPos)
                    break
                end
            end

            ValueHelper:SetValue(deer,DeerValue.targetPlayer,player)
            break
        end
    end

    if not spawnCFrame then
        if state ~= GameEnum.DeerState.Peep then return end
        state = GameEnum.DeerState.Peep
        local campfire:Model = MapHelper:GetCampfire()
        local range = GameHelper:GetCampfireRange() + 90
        local campfirePos = campfire:GetPivot().Position

        local x,z = CommonFunc:GetDir2D(math.random()*360)
        local deerPos = Vector3.new(x*range,campfirePos.Y,z*range)
        spawnCFrame = CFrame.new(deerPos,campfirePos)
    end

    GameHelper:PivotDeer(spawnCFrame + Vector3.yAxis * 15)
    ValueHelper:SetValue(deer,DeerValue.state,state)
    deer:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.Deer)
end

function GameHelper:CraftTakeDamage(attacker:Model,craft:Model,damage:number)

    if not craft:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.DestructibleCraft) then return end
    local v_hp:NumberValue = craft:FindFirstChild("HP")
    if not v_hp then return end
    local beforeHp = v_hp.Value
    v_hp.Value = math.max(v_hp.Value - damage,0)
    if beforeHp > 0 and v_hp.Value <= 0 then
        CraftItemHelper:DestroyCraft(craft,2)
    end
end

function GameHelper:LodeTakeDamage(player:Player,lode:Model,damage:number)
    local v_HP:NumberValue = lode:FindFirstChild("HP")
    if v_HP then
        v_HP.Value = math.max(v_HP.Value - damage,0)
    end

    if not v_HP or v_HP.Value <= 0 then
        lode:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.PickaxeTarget)
        if lode:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Lode) then
            local dropRandomId = lode:GetAttribute("dropRandomId")
            if dropRandomId then
                -- 矿石掉落
                ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItemsByRandomId(dropRandomId,lode:GetPivot().Position + Vector3.new(0,2,0))
            end

            -- 矿脉破碎
            GameHelper.onLodeDied:Fire(player,lode,dropRandomId)
        end

        -- 解体后消失
        GameHelper:DestroyAndSmashTarget(lode,2)
    end
end

function GameHelper:PlayerTakeDamage(player:Player,damage:number,attacker:Model,trueDamage:boolean,hitContext)
    if not trueDamage then
        -- 计算防御减免
        local def = AccessoryHelper:GetDef(player)
        damage -= def

        -- 伤害减免
        local damageReduction = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(player.Character,CharacterValue.damageReduction)
        damage -= damage * damageReduction
    end

    if damage <= 0 then
        if damage > -100 then
            damage = 1
        else
            -- 伤害免疫：返回未受理，调用方不得播放命中反馈。
            return false,0
        end
    end

    if not GameHelper:isAlive(player) then
        return false,0
    end

    ValueHelper:SetValue(player,PlayerValue.lastHurttime,workspace.DistributedGameTime)
    local humanoid:Humanoid = player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")

    local delayTime = 0
    if damage >= humanoid.Health then
        -- 玩家即将死亡，解除坐骑,不然马会跟着死，超无语
        if humanoid.Sit then
            humanoid.Sit = false
            delayTime = 0.1
        end
    end

    if delayTime > 0 then
        task.delay(delayTime,function()
            if humanoid.Parent and player.Parent then
                humanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
                GameHelper.onPlayerTakeDamage:Fire(player,damage,attacker,hitContext)
            end
        end)
    else
        humanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
        GameHelper.onPlayerTakeDamage:Fire(player,damage,attacker,hitContext)
    end

    -- 兼容旧调用方：只新增返回值，不改变原有副作用和事件时序。
    return true,damage
end

function GameHelper:PlayerTakeHungerDamage(player:Player,damage:number,attacker:Model)
    local v_hunber:NumberValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(player,PlayerValue.hunger)
    v_hunber.Value = math.max(v_hunber.Value - damage,0)
end

local function createNpcOverlapParams()
    local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
    for _,tag in ipairs(_npcTags) do
        overlapParams:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(tag))
    end
    overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
    return overlapParams
end

local function collectNpcsFromParts(parts:{BasePart})
    local npcs:{Model} = {}
    local seen = {}
    for _,hit in ipairs(parts) do
        local npcModel:Model? = nil
        for _,tag in ipairs(_npcTags) do
            npcModel = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(hit,tag)
            if npcModel then
                break
            end
        end
        if npcModel and not seen[npcModel] then
            seen[npcModel] = true
            table.insert(npcs,npcModel)
        end
    end
    return npcs
end

function GameHelper:NPCCollect(position:Vector3,ranged:number)
    local overlapParams = createNpcOverlapParams()
    local hits = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(position,ranged,overlapParams)
    return collectNpcsFromParts(hits)
end

function GameHelper:NPCCollectInBox(cframe:CFrame,size:Vector3)
    local overlapParams = createNpcOverlapParams()
    local hits = workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(cframe,size,overlapParams)
    return collectNpcsFromParts(hits)
end

function GameHelper:IsNPC(npc:Model)
    if not npc then return end
    for _,tag in ipairs(_npcTags) do
        if npc:HasTag(tag) then
            return true,npc
        end
    end

    for _,tag in ipairs(_npcTags) do
        local find = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(npc,tag)
        if find then
            return true,find
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function isProtectedOldCowboy(npc:Model):boolean
    return npc ~= nil and npc:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.OldCowboyCompanion)
end

local function isHostileOldCowboyAttacker(attacker:Instance):boolean
    if not attacker or not attacker:IsA("Model") then
        return false
    end
    if attacker:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.AnimalBuddy) then
        return false
    end
    return attacker:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Enemy)
end

function GameHelper:NPCTakeDamage(attacker:Instance,npc:Model,damage:number,damageSource:number?,hitContext)
    if not npc then return false end
    -- Mounted horses are collision shells; all damage must resolve on the rider root.
    local mountedRoot = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(npc,GameEnum.Tag.MountedEnemy)
    if mountedRoot and mountedRoot:IsA("Model") then
        npc = mountedRoot
    end
    if npc:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Ghost) then
        -- if damageSource ~= GameEnum.DamageSource.Light and damageSource ~= GameEnum.DamageSource.HolyWater and damageSource ~= GameEnum.DamageSource.HolySword then
        --     -- 鬼魂免疫伤害,只有光才能伤害幽灵
        --     return false
        -- end
        if not damageSource or not table.find(GameEnum.GhostHitDamageSource,damageSource) then
            -- 鬼魂免疫伤害,只有指定的伤害来源才能伤害幽灵
            return false
        end
    end

    local player:Player = nil
    local pet:Model = nil
    if attacker then
        if attacker:IsA("Player") then
            player = attacker
        elseif attacker:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.AnimalBuddy) then
            pet = attacker
            player = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(pet,AnimalBuddyValue.ownerPlayer)
        end
    end

    local suppressKillRewards = npc:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.OldCowboyAmbusher)

    if isProtectedOldCowboy(npc) then
        if player or not isHostileOldCowboyAttacker(attacker) then
            return false
        end
        if typeof(damage) ~= "number" or damage ~= damage or damage <= 0 then
            return false
        end

        local humanoid:Humanoid = npc:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
            return false
        end

        humanoid.Health = math.max(humanoid.Health - damage,0)
        GameHelper.onNpcTakeDamage:Fire(attacker,npc,damage,damageSource,hitContext)
        return true
    end

    if GameHelper:IsNPC(npc) then
        local humanoid:Humanoid = npc:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local v_hp:NumberValue = npc:FindFirstChild("HP")
        if humanoid then
            if humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
            humanoid:TakeDamage(damage)

            if humanoid.Health > 0 then
                if npc:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Enemy) then
                    if player then
                        -- 转移仇恨
                        ValueHelper:SetValue(npc,EnemyValue.targetPlayer,player)               
                    end
                end
            else
                if npc:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Enemy) and not suppressKillRewards then
                    -- 击杀敌人统计
                    GameHelper:MarkCharacterStats(player,GameEnum.CharacterStatsId.killEnemy)
                end
                if npc:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Animal) or npc:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.DocileAnimal) or npc:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Buddy) then
                    -- 击杀动物统计
                    GameHelper:MarkCharacterStats(player,GameEnum.CharacterStatsId.killAnimals)
                    -- 动物死亡
                    GameHelper.onAnimalDeath:Fire(player,npc,damageSource)
                end
                if player and not suppressKillRewards then
                    GameHelper.onNPCDeath:Fire(player,npc,damageSource)
                end
            end
            if player then
                npc:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.GetDamageDeathTag(player))
            end
            
            GameHelper.onNpcTakeDamage:Fire(attacker,npc,damage,damageSource,hitContext)
            return true
        elseif v_hp and v_hp.Value > 0 then
            local value = v_hp.Value - damage
            if value < 0 then value = 0 end
            v_hp.Value = value
            if player then
                npc:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.GetDamageDeathTag(player))
            end

            GameHelper.onNpcTakeDamage:Fire(attacker,npc,damage,damageSource,hitContext)
            return true
        end
    end

    return false
end

function GameHelper:PlayerMeleeWeaponHitTarget(player:Player,npc:Model,baseDamage:number,damageSource:number?)
    if not damageSource then
        damageSource = GameEnum.DamageSource.MeleeWeapon
    end
    local attackBonus = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(player.Character,CharacterValue.attackBonus)
    local meleeAttackBonus = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(player.Character,CharacterValue.meleeAttackBonus)
    local damage = baseDamage
    damage += baseDamage * attackBonus
    damage += baseDamage * meleeAttackBonus
    local isTakeDamage = GameHelper:NPCTakeDamage(player,npc,damage,damageSource)
    if isTakeDamage then
        GameHelper:AddMuscle(player,0.5)
        GameHelper.onPlayerMeleeWeaponHitTarget:Fire(player,npc,damage)
        GameHelper.onPlayerAttackHitNpc:Fire(player,npc,damage)
    end
    return isTakeDamage == true
end

function GameHelper:PlayerAddFreezeMeter(player:Player,value:number)
    local character = player.Character

    if value > 0 then
        local resistance = ValueHelper:WaitValueValue(character,CharacterValue.freezeResistance) -- 抗性
        resistance = math.min(resistance,0.99)
        value = math.max(value - value * resistance,0)

    v_meter.Value = math.clamp(v_meter.Value + value,0,GameEnum.FreezeMax)
    -- print("寒冷值",v_meter.Value)

local HEAL_EFFECT_RADIUS = 120
local HEAL_EFFECT_RADIUS_SQUARED = HEAL_EFFECT_RADIUS * HEAL_EFFECT_RADIUS

local function sendHealEffect(character:Model)
    local targetPlayer = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
    local recipients = {}
    if targetPlayer and targetPlayer.Parent == Players then
        recipients[targetPlayer] = true
    end

    local targetRoot = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character.PrimaryPart
    if targetRoot and targetRoot:IsA("BasePart") then
        local targetPosition = targetRoot.Position
        for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if recipients[player] then
                continue
            end
            local observerCharacter = player.Character
            local observerRoot = observerCharacter and (observerCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or observerCharacter.PrimaryPart)
            if observerRoot and observerRoot:IsA("BasePart") then
                local delta = observerRoot.Position - targetPosition
                if delta:Dot(delta) <= HEAL_EFFECT_RADIUS_SQUARED then
                    recipients[player] = true
                end
            end
        end
    end

    for player in pairs(recipients) do
        EffectHelper.PlayVisualEffectS2C:FireClient(player,"回血",character)
    end
end

function GameHelper:CharacterForceHeal(character:Model,heal:number,showEffect:boolean?):number
    if not RunService:IsServer()
        or not character
        or not character:IsA("Model")
        or not character:IsDescendantOf(workspace)
        or typeof(heal) ~= "number"
        or heal ~= heal
        or heal == math.huge
        or heal <= 0 then
        return 0
    end

    local humanoid:Humanoid = character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or humanoid.Health >= humanoid.MaxHealth then
        return 0
    end

    local healthBefore = humanoid.Health
    local healthAfter = math.clamp(healthBefore + heal,0,humanoid.MaxHealth)
    local healed = healthAfter - healthBefore
    if healed <= 0 then
        return 0
    end

    humanoid.Health = healthAfter
    if showEffect ~= false then
        sendHealEffect(character)
    end
    return healed
end

function GameHelper:PlayerAutoHeal(player:Player,heal:number)
    local timeNow = workspace.DistributedGameTime
    local lastHurttime = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(player,PlayerValue.lastHurttime)
    if timeNow - lastHurttime < 5 then
        return 0
    end
    local character = player and player.Character
    if not character then
        return 0
    end
    return GameHelper:CharacterForceHeal(character,heal,false)
end

function GameHelper:PlayerForceHeal(player:Player,heal:number):number
    local character = player and player.Character
    if not character then
        return 0
    end
    return GameHelper:CharacterForceHeal(character,heal)
end

function GameHelper:GetDayMultiplier()
    local mul = 1
    local beds:{Model} = CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Bed)
    for _,bed in ipairs(beds) do
        local craftLo = CraftItemHelper:GetLoByCraft(bed)
        if craftLo.param then
            mul += tonumber(craftLo.param)
        end
    end

    local v_dones:{BoolValue} = GameHelper:GetWantedKillList()
    for _,v_done in ipairs(v_dones) do
        if v_done.Value then
            mul += 1
        end
    end

    return mul
end
